title: Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2024: first stage
excerpt: Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2024: first stage
body_html:
Looking back at the results of Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2024, the tournament genuinely surprised fans with the magic of its scores and some unexpected upsets.

Warm congratulations to the winners and prize-winners of the first stage on their success and fine performances at this great national event.

We appreciate the enormous work of the ATTP team and the TOP CUP Academy team in organising and running such a tournament flawlessly — it exceeded everyone’s expectations.

It was an extraordinary, eventful tournament that brought together hundreds of honest, well-meaning table tennis enthusiasts from different regions of Moldova.

The photos from the competition capture everything written above perfectly.
